_comment: Free models Claude Code can talk to. 'Adding' one creates a launcher command (e.g. claude-qwen) that starts Claude Code pointed at that model. Your normal `claude` is never changed. Edit this list to add more.

models.name: Qwen 3.5 9B (local, Ollama)
models.good_for: Best local pick for 16 GB Macs. Tools + thinking, 256K context. Routine edits, tests, docs.
models.limits: Slower than Claude and weaker on large multi-file changes. Runs on your CPU/GPU.

models.name: Qwen 3.8 27B (local, Ollama)
models.good_for: Newest Qwen. Strongest local option for multi-file work, 256K context.
models.limits: Needs a 32 GB+ Mac (18 GB model). On 16 GB it will be unusably slow or fail to load.

models.name: Qwen 2.5 Coder 7B (local, Ollama)
models.good_for: Lightweight laptops. Small code questions and single-file edits.
models.limits: Older (2024) and weakest at tool use. Prefer Qwen 3.5 9B if you have 16 GB RAM.

models.name: Qwen3 Coder (free, OpenRouter cloud)
models.good_for: Big free coding model with nothing to download.
models.limits: Needs a free OpenRouter API key. Free tier is rate-limited, and prompts are sent to OpenRouter.
